motion.name: message-flash
motion.purpose: Message jump highlight; animation disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary button
components.css: .ds-primary{font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji', 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Noto Color Emoji';min-height:2.75rem;border:0;border-radius:var(--radius-lg,.625rem);padding:.5rem .75rem;background:var(--primary);color:var(--primary-foreground);font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.25rem;font-weight:500}.ds-primary:hover{opacity:.9}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.5}

components.name: Secondary button
components.css: .ds-secondary{font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji', 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Noto Color Emoji';min-height:2.75rem;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-lg,.625rem);padding:.5rem .75rem;background:transparent;color:var(--foreground);font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.25rem}.ds-secondary:hover{background:var(--accent)}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-secondary:disabled{opacity:.5}

components.name: Icon button
components.description: Quiet header action with an accessible name.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon" aria-label="Search chats"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg></button>

components.name: Native select
components.css: .ds-field{font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji', 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Noto Color Emoji';display:block;color:var(--muted-foreground);font-size:.75rem}.ds-select{font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji', 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Noto Color Emoji';display:block;margin-top:.5rem;min-height:2.75rem;width:100%;border:1px solid var(--input);border-radius:var(--radius-lg,.625rem);padding:.5rem .75rem;background:var(--background);color:var(--foreground);font-size:1rem;line-height:1.5rem}.ds-select:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-select:disabled{opacity:.5}@media(min-width:640px){.ds-select{font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.25rem}}

components.name: Settings navigation
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="Settings sections"><button aria-current="page">Appearance</button><button>Resource usage</button><button>Free up resources</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav{display:grid;gap:.25rem}.ds-nav button{font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji', 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Noto Color Emoji';min-height:2.75rem;border:0;border-radius:var(--radius-lg,.625rem);padding:.75rem;background:transparent;color:var(--muted-foreground);font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.25rem;text-align:left}.ds-nav button[aria-current],.ds-nav button:hover{background:var(--accent);color:var(--foreground)}.ds-nav button[aria-current]{font-weight:500}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Attachment chip
components.description: Truncated attachment name and separate removal action.
components.html: example.png
components.css: .ds-chip{font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji', 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Noto Color Emoji';display:inline-flex;max-width:100%;align-items:center;gap:.25rem;border-radius:var(--radius-md,.5rem);background:var(--muted);color:var(--foreground);padding-left:.5rem;font-size:.75rem;line-height:1rem}.ds-name{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.ds-chip button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;width:2.25rem;height:2.25rem;border:0;border-radius:var(--radius-md,.5rem);background:transparent;color:inherit}.ds-chip button:hover{background:var(--accent)}.ds-chip button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring);outline-offset:3px;}

narrative.overview: This document records the existing web UI after a scoped refinement of chat and settings. Semantic palettes, system sans text, Lucide icons, borders, and native controls remain the visual authority. It describes implemented conventions; no replacement identity or display typeface was introduced.
keyCharacteristics: Semantic themes across chat and settings.
Readable compact text with larger touch controls.
Flat bordered surfaces; native disclosures, inputs, and dialogs.

rules.name: The Semantic Roles Rule
rules.body: Use semantic roles for surfaces, text, actions, selection, and danger; palette values belong in the shared theme source.

dos: Do use semantic CSS tokens so every installed theme updates the same controls.
Do retain accessible names for icon actions and visible focus feedback.
Do let suggestions populate an editable, focused draft before sending.
Do keep mobile conversation space and the composer reachable.
donts: Don't replace the installed palette or typography when extending these surfaces.
Don't remove native control behavior or disabled/loading feedback.
